props.text: Schedule Manager demo — data.schedules is bound to the GATEWAY's real user schedules (system.user.getSchedules() via a script transform), plus two synthetic demo schedules appended by the binding. Click a schedule to paint its weekly availability; selection is two-way via state.selectedSchedule. Read-only milestone (M0) — editing lands with M1.
